question: Should Telegram expose standalone `pin` and `unpin` message-tool actions, and should `unpin` require an explicit `messageId` rather than using Telegram's active-pinned-message default?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the feature expands agent authority over persistent Telegram chat state and needs a maintainer-approved gate, default posture, and target semantics before implementation.

options.title: Approve gated explicit actions
options.body: Add Telegram-plugin-owned `pin` and `unpin` actions behind a pin-specific action gate, require explicit message ids unless separately approved, and require live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep delivery pin only
options.body: Do not expose standalone pin/unpin actions yet; keep the existing `delivery.pin` behavior for messages OpenClaw just sent.

options.title: Request design first
options.body: Ask for a short design note covering admin-right expectations, per-account gating, forum-topic behavior, and implicit unpin semantics before implementation.

recommendation.title: Approve gated explicit actions
recommendation.body: Add Telegram-plugin-owned `pin` and `unpin` actions behind a pin-specific action gate, require explicit message ids unless separately approved, and require live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the prior detailed product/security review and have the strongest recent history across the affected Telegram action, docs, and routing surfaces.
